oil.when: 2023, using the right selector wheel on the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the service shown has been done).
Turn the power mode to ON without starting the engine.
Roll the right selector wheel until the Maintenance Minder screen shows.
Press and hold the right selector wheel for about 10 seconds until reset mode appears.
Roll the wheel to the item you had done, or to All due items, and press the wheel to reset it. Repeat for any other item you had done.
oil.note: Choose Cancel to leave without resetting.

tpms.when: 2025 (indirect system, calibrated from the gauge display)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker. Calibration will not work with the compact spare on.
Stop completely, shift to P, and turn the power mode to ON.
Use the right selector wheel on the steering wheel to reach Vehicle settings in the gauge display, then press the wheel.
Roll to TPMS calibration and press the wheel.
Roll to Calibrate and press the wheel. If the display says calibration failed to start, select Calibrate again.
Drive normally. Calibration finishes by itself after about 30 minutes in total at roughly 30 to 60 mph.
tpms.note: Recalibrate after any pressure change, tire rotation or new tire. If the light stays on with the right tires properly inflated, have the system checked. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.
